name: hud
description: Heads-up display for Claude Code and Copilot CLI: token-weather band with PR, git and limit forecasts, turn footer, tool rows, spinner, /weather, /subagents and /ctx panes (Claude mod), a two-line status line for both CLIs, and reply rewrites (links, paths, commits, states, pass/fail, secrets, URLs, times) in Claude Code and pi

glyphs.title: Reply: glyphs
glyphs.description: Nerd Font glyphs in reply rewrites (a feature can turn its own off). NO_COLOR turns them off too.

colour.title: Reply: colour
colour.description: Colour in reply rewrites (a feature can turn its own off). NO_COLOR turns it off too.

replySecrets.title: Reply: mask secrets
replySecrets.description: GitHub, OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS and Slack tokens, bearer tokens and private keys keep their prefix and lose the rest, code included. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).

replyUrls.title: Reply: short URLs
replyUrls.description: Long URLs drawn as owner/repo#12, group/proj!4, repo@sha, repo › path:line or host and short path; the link stays. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).

replyRefs.title: Reply: work-item links
replyRefs.description: #123, !45, owner/repo#12 and AB#77 drawn as links to the forge of upstream, else origin. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).

replyState.title: Reply: work-item state
replyState.description: Open, merged, closed or draft glyph on a work-item reference, read from gh, glab or az and cached for the session. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).

replyPaths.title: Reply: short paths
replyPaths.description: Absolute paths drawn as <repo> › path, <repo>[worktree] › path or ~/path; only paths that exist. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).

replyFileLinks.title: Reply: file links
replyFileLinks.description: Paths and file:line[:col] made links that open the editor below; only files that exist. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).

replyCommits.title: Reply: commit links
replyCommits.description: Commit SHAs of the session repository drawn as links to the forge; only real commits. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).

replyTimes.title: Reply: times
replyTimes.description: ISO-8601 timestamps drawn as local time and how long ago. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).

replyStatus.title: Reply: pass/fail
replyStatus.description: pass, ok, ✓ green; fail, error, ✗ red; skipped, pending dim, in table cells, list items and name: status lines; counts after a table or list. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).

editor.title: Reply: editor
editor.description: What a file link opens; custom uses the template below.

editorUrl.title: Reply: custom editor URL
editorUrl.description: For editor custom: a URL with {path} {line} {col}, e.g. nvim://open?file={path}&line={line}.
